messages:
Ana: quick PSA — CI turned red on main after merge of #4821. pre-commit/pyright failing in kvcache. Can someone quick-check?
BuildBot: CI failed for commit abcdef1 (merge PR 4821) — pyright/typecheck step failed. See https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/12345
Sam: pinging the guild. can you paste the pyright error?
Ana: here's the tail of the log i see locally: 
```
/opt/workspace/redwood/kvcache/cache.py:120: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "None", variable has type "Mapping[str, Any]")
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 42 source files)
```
Sam: hmm looks like an Optional slipped through. did someone bump pyright or typings recently?
Mei: i upgraded the tools container this morning (pyright 1.1.2 -> 1.2.0) in a different PR, but that was gated. could be config drift.
Ana: i also ran pre-commit locally and reproduced. quick minimal repro.
Sam: can we rerun CI to rule out flake? if it persists, can we bisect to the offending commit?
Ana: triggered a rerun: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/12345/rerun (requested by @ana)
CI Bot: Rerun scheduled for build 12345. queued on runners pool-1.
Mei: local quick fix is to tighten the annotation in cache.py: change Mapping[str, Any] to Optional[Mapping[str, Any]] or guard assignment. but we should probe whether the upstream change expects that to be non-None.
Sam: if it's a genuine typing regression, I'd prefer minimally invasive fix + follow-up ticket to audit the change that relaxed the contract. if rerun passes, can we still bisect?
Ana: rerun failed with same pyright error. i started a bisect on my laptop to find which merge introduced the reg.
Sam: assign to me if you can't finish the bisect. i can run a faster binary search with the CI history.
Mei: for local folks, repro commands i used: 
```bash
# from repo root
pipx run pyright --project tsconfig.json
pre-commit run --all-files pyright
```
Sam: thanks. Ana — if you can push a tiny type fix as a PR, we can get green and open a follow-up to revert/clean up later.
Ana: pushed quick fix to PR #4822 (adds Optional[...] and a small guard). force-pushed branch. requesting CI rerun.
CI Bot: Build 12367 triggered for PR 4822. Running pre-commit -> pyright -> tests.
CI Bot: Build 12367 PASSED (pre-commit/pyright).
Sam: nice, thanks. leaving a note on the PR to add a changelog entry for the tools version bump if needed. :thumbsup:
Mei: also flagging this for monday sync — we should pin the pyright version in tools/ so we don't get silent drift.
Ana: will follow up in the PR and open a tiny ops ticket. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
Sam: thanks, resolving our side.
